items.question: How does SWAYA compare to Plex, Jellyfin, or Kodi?
items.answer: Unlike Plex, Jellyfin, or Kodi, SWAYA requires zero server setup, zero transcoding overhead, and zero user accounts. It is a lightweight desktop app built specifically to organize and play movies and videos stored directly on your local hard drives using an embedded high-performance MPV player.

items.question: Can SWAYA replace FileBot for batch renaming movies and shows?
items.answer: Yes. SWAYA includes an automated regex batch organizer that identifies movies, TV episodes, and adult scenes via TMDb, StashDB, and ThePornDB. It renames and sorts messy download folders into standard Plex/Jellyfin-ready structures with collision-safe previews.

items.question: Does SWAYA work with external hard drives and USB storage?
items.answer: Yes, perfectly. SWAYA is designed for external hard drives, USB disks, and local NAS folders. Your catalog, posters, and watch history remain instantly browsable and searchable even when external drives are temporarily disconnected.

items.question: Is SWAYA completely offline and private?
items.answer: Yes. SWAYA stores all metadata, local databases, and custom collections 100% locally on your machine. There are no tracking scripts, no telemetry, and no account requirements. A dedicated stealth hotkey lets you instantly hide sensitive collections.

items.question: What video playback engine does SWAYA use?
items.answer: SWAYA is powered by a high-performance, embedded MPV player engine. It delivers GPU-accelerated 4K HDR playback, seamless multi-audio and subtitle track switching, custom shaders, and instant playback resume.

items.question: Which metadata scrapers and APIs are supported?
items.answer: SWAYA integrates directly with mainstream and niche providers including TMDb, OMDb, StashDB, FansDB, and ThePornDB for automated multi-source metadata matching, poster downloads, actor filmographies, and studio logos.

items.question: How does the license work?
items.answer: SWAYA is a one-time €39 purchase for lifetime access. It includes all future updates and can be activated on up to 3 personal Windows PCs without recurring subscription fees.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: SWAYA is engineered as an offline-first desktop application. We prioritize your privacy with zero telemetry, complete local data storage, and strict cryptographic protections.
privacy.section1Text: SWAYA is an offline-first desktop media center and video player. Your media files, filenames, folder structures, playback history, ratings, tags, and personal notes are stored strictly on your local computer in a local SQLite database (data/swaya.db).
privacy.section1Point1: We do not transmit, index, or inspect your video files, downloads, or disk contents.
privacy.section1Point2: We do not record playback time, viewing sessions, or application usage habits.
privacy.section1Point3: All metadata scraping queries (TMDb, OMDb, StashDB, etc.) are executed directly from your local machine to the chosen API provider without proxying through our servers.
privacy.section2Text: When you purchase a SWAYA license, your payment is securely processed by Stripe Inc. We never receive or store your raw payment details (such as credit card numbers, CVV, or banking credentials).
privacy.section2Point1: Data Collected: Customer email address, customer name (optional), Stripe transaction ID, and timestamp.
privacy.section2Point2: Purpose: Solely to generate your cryptographically signed license key, dispatch your confirmation email, and provide customer support.
privacy.section2Point3: Retention: Billing records are maintained for licensing verification and accounting compliance as required by applicable tax law.
privacy.section3Text: When you activate a license key on a desktop device, a one-time cryptographic request is sent to our activation server to issue an HMAC-SHA256 offline license token:
privacy.section3Point1: The activation request contains an irreversible, hashed hardware identifier to ensure compliance with the 3-device seat limit.
privacy.section3Point2: Once activated, the license token is stored locally on your machine. SWAYA functions 100% offline without requiring a persistent internet connection.
privacy.section3Point3: You may deactivate a device at any time directly from the Settings panel to release the seat.
privacy.section4Text: On our marketing website (swaya.xyz), we utilize privacy-focused, zero-PII analytics to measure page load performance, Core Web Vitals, and aggregate traffic:
privacy.section4Point1: We do not track cross-site browsing, fingerprint your device, or sell marketing data to third-party advertising networks.
privacy.section4Point2: Performance analytics are strictly opt-in via our GDPR cookie consent banner.
privacy.section5Text: Under GDPR, CCPA, and applicable global data privacy regulations, you have the right to request access to, rectification of, or deletion of your billing email and licensing records from our activation server.
privacy.section5Contact: For any inquiries, data deletion requests, or licensing support, contact us directly at
